name: Lung cancer survival prediction benchmark (Random Survival Forest comparison)
description: An evaluation suite comparing survival analysis methods (notably Random Survival Forests) for predicting lung cancer survival outcomes on clinical datasets.
reputation: Moderately used in methodological survival-analysis comparisons within medical informatics; of particular interest to researchers evaluating prognostic models.
notes: Clinical survival datasets typically have censoring and limited sample sizes; results can be dataset-specific and prone to overfitting. Non-LLM benchmark focused on classical survival models; consider reporting both C-index and Brier score and performing external validation.
